title: Unit 22 Consolidation: Language and Machines
goal: I can use the words for machine language, small languages and language change.
I can use *könnyen meglehet, hogy*, sentences without a doer and adverbs of certainty.
I can use *ha* + conditional and adverbs of speed when writing about language and machines.
